limits: Shell count is not reference-fidelity acceptance; shared roots are permitted.
A pole/fan or global narrowing does not prove a visible hooked strand end. Rounded caps and fused head extrema can narrow.
lockNames order is used only when component count and contiguous triangle ranges agree; final native face labels are a separate cross-check.
Self intersections and inter-shell volume intersections are not tested by this closure diagnostic.
coordinates: glTF world rest skin/morph coordinates; Blender conversion=(x,-z,y)
